capabilities: Render headings and bullet lists as an editable SVG mind map
Restructure nodes with keyboard shortcuts and drag-and-drop
Add emoji icons and tags to nodes and filter by tag
Draw dashed association lines for wikilinks between branches
Export the map or a selected branch as SVG or PNG
disambiguation: Not a link-management or backlink tool; the name refers to mind-mapping note content, not curating links.
extras: Documentation is provided in both English and Chinese; installation is manual (copy release files into the plugins folder) rather than through a community-plugin listing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or edit a note's heading/list structure as an interactive mind map while keeping the file as plain Markdown.
summary: Mind-map editor that renders a note's headings and bullet lists as an SVG tree you can edit, with changes written back to plain Markdown.
